generation.scope: All finite middle edges from a fixed admissible length-twenty input are recovered exactly as Plucker bases of its fifteen quartics admitting four independent linear annihilators, modulo GL6. For the general fifteen-dimensional component exactly two Grassmannians pass; both are isolated reduced even among all Grassmannians containing the quartic model.

open_mathematics: Use centers of deficient Plucker systems on the input blowup to constrain singular finite eight-cofactor pencils and classify their curve components. Complete finite-window regularity and other uncovered strata.
